quarterly_data.signal: Data centers represented 28% and 26% of Virginia Power's electricity sales for the years ended December 31, 2025 and 2024; their concentration primarily in Loudoun County, Virginia requires significant investment in electric transmission and generation. Virginia Power requires deposits for expensive long lead-time equipment with reimbursement clauses for canceled projects, and under the 2025 Biennial Review order will begin in January 2027 to require a 14-year contract, collateral over that period and demand minimums for high load customers at connection.
